title: Coordinate homology product for finite-free zero-differential internal Hom
statement: Let C be a small category with a Grothendieck topology S and a sheaf R of commutative rings, and use its abelian category of sheaves of modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let E,K be integer-indexed cochain complexes [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules]. Assume every differential of E is zero, that E is zero outside some finite integer interval, and that every E.X p is isomorphic to a finite free sheaf. Write P=Hom(E,K) [def-pur-hom-complex], with the fixed product projections π of [lem-sc-hom-complex-projections], and internal Hom from [def-pur-sheaf-hom]. For every n there are maps g(p,q,h):H^n(P)→Hom(E.X p,H^q(K)) for p+n=q with proof h. The fan with vertex H^n(P) and projections g(p,p+n,rfl) is a product-limit fan. Moreover, for every such p,q,h and every d:Z^n(P)→Hom(E.X p,Z^q(K)), if d followed by Hom(id,iCycles_K q) equals iCycles_P n followed by π(E,K,n,p,q,h), then d followed by Hom(id,homologyπ_K q) equals homologyπ_P n followed by g(p,q,h). No concentration of K and no evaluation map on H(E) is assumed.

proof.text: Let P=Hom(E,K) and F_p=Hom(E.X p,-). The chosen projections of homComplex_projections_exists and hzero give coordinate short-complex morphisms τ_p from P.sc n to F_p applied to K.sc'(p+prev n,p+n,p+next n). Their three components are exactly the fixed projections. ShortComplex.isLimitOfIsLimitπ and the three chosen degreewise product limits show that these τ_p form a limiting fan of short complexes. The proof of homObj_isZero_left checks on sections that internal Hom from a zero source is zero, so the three objects of every coordinate short complex are zero outside the finite support interval.

Use finiteFreeInternalHomExact with a chosen finite-free isomorphism for each E.X p. The internal-Hom functor is additive, as checked on sections. Functor.exact_tfae converts its preservation of short exact sequences into PreservesHomology. To apply the additive ShortComplex.homologyFunctor to the preceding fan, the proved private helper map_finiteSupport_fan first restricts it to Finset.Icc a b, extending any test fan by zero projections outside the interval. This restriction is limiting by uniqueness of maps to zero objects. Mathlib preservesFiniteProductsOfAdditive preserves its finite product; the image of a zero object is zero, so the resulting fan extends back to a limiting fan over all integers. Reindex K.sc' by K.isoSc' and use ShortComplex.mapHomologyIso to identify each coordinate with Hom(E.X p,H^(p+n)(K)). The proved helper fan_postcompose_iso transports the fan along these coordinate isomorphisms, defining g and proving its product property.

For an additive homology-preserving functor F and a short-complex morphism φ:T→S.map F, the proved helper exactHomologyMap_cycle_eq identifies any cycle lift d with cyclesMap φ followed by S.mapCyclesIso F: both have the same composite with F.map S.iCycles, which is monic because F preserves finite limits. The identities mapCyclesIso_eq, mapHomologyIso_eq, and LeftHomologyData.homologyπ_comp_homologyIso_hom prove compatibility of the two comparison isomorphisms with the quotient map. ShortComplex.homologyπ_naturality then yields the desired equation. Apply this helper to τ_p followed by the inverse of the mapped K.isoSc'. Its middle component is precisely the chosen projection, and homologyMap_comp identifies its homology map with the constructed g. Finally substitute q=p+n using the supplied equality.

theorem finiteFreeZero_homologyProduct
    {C : Type u} [SmallCategory C] {S : GrothendieckTopology C}
    (R : Sheaf S CommRingCat.{u})
    (E K : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u}
      ((sheafCompose S (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj R)) ℤ)
    (n : ℤ) (hzero : ∀ a b : ℤ, E.d a b = 0)
    (hsupp : ∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ k : ℤ, k < a ∨ b < k → IsZero (E.X k))
    (hfree : ∀ k : ℤ, ∃ r : ℕ, Nonempty (E.X k ≅
      SheafOfModules.free (ULift.{u} (Fin r)))) :
    let P := homComplex (R := R) E K
    ∃ g : ∀ (p q : ℤ), p + n = q →
        (P.homology n ⟶ SheafOfModules.homObj (R := R) (E.X p) (K.homology q)),
      Nonempty (IsLimit (Fan.mk (P.homology n)
        (fun p : ℤ ↦ g p (p + n) rfl))) ∧
      ∀ (p q : ℤ) (hpq : p + n = q)
        (d : P.cycles n ⟶ SheafOfModules.homObj (R := R) (E.X p) (K.cycles q)),
        d ≫ SheafOfModules.homObjMap (R := R) (𝟙 _) (K.iCycles q) =
          P.iCycles n ≫ (Classical.choose (homComplex_projections_exists (R := R)))
            E K n p q hpq →
        d ≫ SheafOfModules.homObjMap (R := R) (𝟙 _) (K.homologyπ q) =
          P.homologyπ n ≫ g p q hpq
